name: oydodo-skills
description: Thirteen curated skills for philosophical judgment, long-term decision navigation, domain modeling, evidence research, prototyping, lean coding and technical writing.

interface.longDescription: Philosophical foundation; independent judgment; crux-first reasoning; Wayfinder decision maps; grilling; domain modeling; evidence research; lightweight prototyping; requirements interviews; coding simplicity; and three technical writing skills.
defaultPrompt: Review this decision and challenge its assumptions when necessary.
Choose the decisive factor in this architecture tradeoff.
Write a README that explains why, how, and expected results.
Use Wayfinder to map open decisions, their blockers, and the fog of war in this multi-session project.
